name: Prof. Dr. Emrah Arslan
training: Specialisation in plastic surgery, Çukurova University (1999)
Led plastic surgery departments at Mersin University, Adana Numune Hospital and Çanakkale Onsekiz Mart University
Fellowships and visits: Cleveland Clinic; El Paso Cosmetic Surgery Center
memberships: Turkish Society of Plastic, Reconstructive and Aesthetic Surgery (TPRECD)

summary.en: Turkish-trained plastic surgeon listed by Hygeia Hospital Tirana, where the profile lists rhinoplasty and revision rhinoplasty among the procedures performed.
summary.it: Chirurgo plastico formato in Turchia, indicato da Hygeia Hospital Tirana, dove il profilo elenca rinoplastica e rinoplastica secondaria tra gli interventi eseguiti.
summary.sq: Kirurg plastik i formuar në Turqi, i përmendur nga Hygeia Hospital Tirana, ku profili liston rinoplastikën dhe rinoplastikën rishikuese ndër procedurat që kryen.
